scripts.check: cargo check --workspace && bun run prepare:demo && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p examples/react/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && biome check .
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && bun run build:packages && bun run build:native && bun test packages scripts/benchmark-metrics.test.ts
scripts.demo:native: bun run build:packages && bun run build:native
scripts.demo: bun run demo:native && bun run --cwd examples/react dev
scripts.demo:build: bun run demo:native && bun run --cwd examples/react build
scripts.prepare:demo: bun run build:packages && bun run build:native && bun run packages/alien-vite/src/cli.ts prepare examples/react
scripts.test:package: bun run build:packages && bun run build:native && bun run scripts/test-package.ts
scripts.bench:css: bun run build:native && bun run scripts/bench-css.ts
scripts.bench:compiler: bun run build:native --release && bun run scripts/bench-compiler.ts
scripts.test:frameworks: bun run build:packages && bun run build:native && bun run scripts/test-frameworks.ts
